title: MeshGraphNets Airfoil — SU2 ground-truth test trajectory 009
citation: Learning Mesh-Based Simulation with Graph Networks, ICLR 2021, arXiv:2010.03409
time_note: Elapsed time is frame ordinal times dt from the distributed meta.json. Absolute simulation start is not supplied. The paper appendix lists 0.008 s, which differs from the downloadable metadata; this importer follows the actual download and records the discrepancy.
field_note: The paper section4 defines the Airfoil state as momentum and density; footnote3 defines displayed velocity as momentum/density. Accordingly the vector stored under the generic key velocity is divided by density for visualization/export. Pressure and density are copied unchanged. This is a solver ground-truth trajectory, not a learned model rollout.
license_note: The associated source repository has an Apache-2.0 license (retained). The downloadable dataset does not include a separate license statement; no separate data-license grant is asserted.
transformations: Exactly one complete original TFRecord was downloaded by HTTP byte range; both TFRecord CRC32C checksums are verified.
All 601 original snapshots and 5233 nodes are retained. Momentum/density yields displayed velocity; no temporal interpolation, solver run, model prediction or invented frames.
Original triangle connectivity is retained; the exact airfoil boundary is recovered from boundary edges.
Source (x,y) maps to scene (X=x-0.5,Z=y). Scene Y repeats the 2D field for viewing and has no spanwise variation.
Spatial values inside triangles use barycentric interpolation. The scene box crops the much larger source domain.
Playback at 20 snapshots/s takes 30 seconds; playback speed is separate from source time.
